property_summary: For any caller, the owner should remain unchanged after a non-owner attempts setOwner; the bug allows any caller to change the owner.
Only the owner can change the owner returned by owner(); the bug lets any caller change it.

For any caller, if the call to setOwner does not revert, then the resulting owner must equal the caller; the buggy version violates this because it allows a non-owner caller to succeed without the owner being set to the caller.

A non-zero address can never become the owner in the mutant because only address(0) passes the modifier, so the setOwner call reverts for any realistic new owner, while the reference allows any owner to change it.

After any call to setOwner, the owner state variable must equal the address argument passed; the bug version leaves owner unchanged, violating this for any caller when a new _owner different from the current owner is provided.
